meaning_en: to succeed in doing something difficult
example_en: We hope to accomplish our goals by next year.
examples_extra: She accomplished all her goals before thirty.
They accomplished the task in record time.
note_fa: «رسمی‌تر از achieve؛ با a great deal می‌آید.»

meaning_en: very skilled at something
example_en: She is an accomplished pianist and singer.
examples_extra: She is an accomplished concert pianist.
He is an accomplished speaker of three languages.
note_fa: «یعنی «ماهر و کاربلد»؛ برای هنرمند: an accomplished pianist.»

meaning_en: something successful achieved after a lot of effort
example_en: Finishing the marathon was a great accomplishment for him.
examples_extra: Winning the prize was a great accomplishment.
Learning to read is a major accomplishment for a child.
note_fa: «موفقیت پس از تلاش زیاد؛ در جدول خانوادهٔ کلمات کتاب.»

meaning_en: possible to achieve or reach
example_en: Setting small goals makes them more achievable.
examples_extra: Set achievable goals for the first month.
The target is ambitious but achievable.
note_fa: «یعنی «قابل دستیابی»؛ در جدول خانوادهٔ کلمات کتاب.»

meaning_en: to succeed in doing something good
example_en: She wants to achieve her dreams.
examples_extra: She achieved her dream of becoming a pilot.
Hard work helped him achieve success.
note_fa: «یعنی «موفق شدن در کاری»؛ اسمش achievement است.»

meaning_en: something good that you have done
example_en: Winning the race was a great achievement.
examples_extra: Graduating from university was her greatest achievement.
The prize honours his achievements in science.
note_fa: «کار موفق پس از تلاش؛ مثل نوشتن یک کتاب.»

meaning_en: a formal decision or arrangement
example_en: They reached an agreement after long talks.
examples_extra: The two companies signed an agreement yesterday.
We finally reached an agreement after long talks.
note_fa: عبارت‌ها: reach/sign an agreement؛ in agreement with.

meaning_en: a goal or purpose
example_en: My aim is to learn English well.
examples_extra: Our main aim is to finish by Friday.
She achieved her aim of becoming a doctor.
note_fa: عبارت: with the aim of + ing.

meaning_en: A strong desire to achieve something.
example_en: Her ambition is to become a doctor.
examples_extra: His ambition is to become a pilot one day.
She finally achieved her ambition of running a marathon.
note_fa: عبارت: sb's ambition to do sth.

meaning_en: To achieve or reach something difficult.
example_en: She hopes to attain her goals.
examples_extra: She attained the highest score in the class.
It took years to attain his goal of becoming a doctor.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از reach است؛ با اهداف بزرگ می‌آید.

meaning_en: Possible to achieve or reach.
example_en: Setting realistic and attainable goals is important.
examples_extra: Set small, attainable goals for yourself this month.
With hard work, success is attainable for everyone.

meaning_en: The act of achieving something.
example_en: Her academic attainment was impressive.
examples_extra: The prize was given for high attainment in science.
Her greatest attainment was finishing medical school with honours.
note_fa: رسمی است؛ در گفتار روزمره achievement رایج‌تر است.

meaning_en: A plan or action has an opposite, bad result.
example_en: His clever plan backfired and caused more problems.
examples_extra: His joke about the boss backfired and made the whole team uncomfortable.
The new tax plan backfired when thousands of people protested in the streets.
note_fa: برنامه‌ای که نتیجه معکوس می‌دهد — مثل تفنگی که به عقب شلیک کند.

meaning_en: To make an effort to do something.
example_en: Don't bother to call me, I'll be home late.
examples_extra: Do not bother to call me back tonight.
The loud noise from the street bothered him.
note_fa: don't bother to do یعنی زحمت نکن.

meaning_en: To become separated from something.
example_en: The button came off my shirt.
examples_extra: One of the buttons has come off my coat.
The paint started to come off the old door.
note_fa: مثلاً دکمه از لباس «کنده شدن».

meaning_en: An agreement where everyone gives up something.
example_en: We reached a compromise after a long discussion.
examples_extra: They finally reached a compromise after long talks.
Marriage needs a lot of give and take and compromise.
note_fa: reach a compromise = به توافق رسیدن.

meaning_en: To deal successfully with a difficult situation.
example_en: She is learning to cope with stress.
examples_extra: She could not cope with the pressure at work.
How do you cope with stress?
note_fa: همیشه با with: cope with a difficult situation.

meaning_en: Not easy to do or understand.
example_en: This math problem is very difficult.
examples_extra: The maths exam was really diicult this year.
It is diicult to learn a language without practice.
note_fa: همان difficult؛ «دشوار».

meaning_en: A problem or something that is not easy.
example_en: He had difficulty sleeping last night.
examples_extra: She had great diiculty finding a job in the city.
He solved the diiculty by asking his teacher.
note_fa: have difficulty (in) doing یعنی «دشواری داشتن در».

meaning_en: A strong hope or ambition.
example_en: My dream is to travel the world.
examples_extra: Her dream is to become a pilot one day.
He achieved his dream of opening a restaurant.
note_fa: یعنی آرزو؛ dream of doing یعنی آرزوی انجام کاری.

meaning_en: To lose strength or momentum; to hesitate.
example_en: His voice faltered as he spoke about his loss.
examples_extra: Her voice faltered as she spoke.
The team's confidence began to falter.
note_fa: یعنی «لرزان و متزلزل شدن».

meaning_en: To fail in business.
example_en: Many small businesses fold in their first year.
examples_extra: The small shop folded after only one year.
Many startups fold because they run out of money.
note_fa: «ورشکست شدن»؛ برای کسب‌وکارهای کوچک.

meaning_en: to achieve something you hoped for.
example_en: He wants to fulfil his dreams.
examples_extra: She worked hard to fulfil her dream.
The company must fulfil its promises.
note_fa: برآورده کردن؛ املای آمریکایی fulfill.

meaning_en: making you feel happy and satisfied.
example_en: Teaching is a very fulfilling job.
examples_extra: Teaching is a very fulfilling job.
She found volunteering deeply fulfilling.
note_fa: رضایت‌بخش.

meaning_en: a feeling of happiness from achieving something.
example_en: She found great fulfilment in her work.
examples_extra: He found fulfilment in helping others.
The job gave her a sense of fulfilment.
note_fa: احساس رضایت از رسیدن به هدف.

meaning_en: A business fails financially and closes.
example_en: Many small businesses go under during a recession.
examples_extra: Many small shops go under in a crisis.
The business may go under soon.
note_fa: «ورشکست شدن»؛ غیررسمی.

meaning_en: To make a mistake or fail.
example_en: Something went wrong with the computer.
examples_extra: Even good plans sometimes go wrong.
If things go wrong, call me.
note_fa: «اشتباه شدن/خراب شدن»؛ برنامه یا کار.

meaning_en: Something you want to achieve in the future.
example_en: My goal is to learn English fluently.
examples_extra: Her goal is to become a doctor.
He set himself a new goal.
note_fa: «هدف»؛ a goal in life.

meaning_en: To become or make something firm or solid.
example_en: The cement will harden overnight.
examples_extra: The cement will harden in a few hours.
Years of hard life had hardened his heart.
note_fa: سفت شدن؛ هم فیزیکی هم احساسی (دل سخت شدن).

meaning_en: The quality of being firm and solid.
example_en: The hardness of the rock surprised them.
examples_extra: The hardness of the rock made digging very difficult.
Diamonds are famous for their extreme hardness.
note_fa: سختی؛ اسم harden است.

meaning_en: Experience difficulty doing something.
example_en: I have trouble sleeping when it's hot.
examples_extra: He will have real trouble sleeping well at night.
We may have some trouble finding the old house.
note_fa: دشواری داشتن؛ have trouble + ing.

meaning_en: Succeed in doing something difficult.
example_en: Did you manage to finish your work?
examples_extra: She manages to finish on time.
I can't manage the whole walk.
note_fa: «از پس کاری برآمدن»؛ manage to do.

meaning_en: Something you must do; a duty.
example_en: It's my obligation to help them.
examples_extra: Parents have an obligation to care for their children.
I feel an obligation to help my old neighbours.
note_fa: تعهد/وظیفه؛ have an obligation to یعنی «موظف بودن».

meaning_en: to arrive at a place
example_en: We will reach the summit by noon.
examples_extra: We reached the hotel at midnight.
The news reached us yesterday.
note_fa: reach + مکان بدون حرف اضافه: reach the station.

meaning_en: to understand or become aware of something
example_en: I suddenly realised my mistake.
examples_extra: I suddenly realised that I had left my keys at home.
She realised her mistake too late.
note_fa: متوجه شدن؛ در آمریکا realize نوشته می‌شود.

meaning_en: Safe from danger or harm.
example_en: The building is very secure with cameras.
examples_extra: The building is very secure.
Make sure the door is secure.
note_fa: یعنی امن؛ secure a job یعنی شغل به دست آوردن.

meaning_en: To achieve a desired result or goal.
example_en: She worked hard and finally succeeded in her project.
examples_extra: Hard work helped him succeed.
She succeeded in business after years of work.
note_fa: موفق شدن.

meaning_en: Achieving a good result in work or business.
example_en: The new business was a great success.
examples_extra: Her success made the family proud.
The party was a great success.
note_fa: موفقیت.

meaning_en: Achieving a good result, especially in studies.
example_en: She was very successful in her exams.
examples_extra: He is a successful businessman.
The operation was successful and quick.
note_fa: موفق.

meaning_en: In a way that achieves a desired result.
example_en: They successfully completed the difficult mission.
examples_extra: The project was completed successfully.
She successfully passed all her exams.
note_fa: با موفقیت.

meaning_en: Aim at something or someone.
example_en: The campaign targets young voters.
examples_extra: The ad targets young people.
We target new customers daily.
note_fa: «هدف قرار دادن».
